title: vitex urbanii
intro: Vitex urbanii, commonly known as the Cape chaste tree, is a plant species native to South Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support menstrual health, alleviate symptoms of menopause, and provide relief from anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Vitex urbanii are attributed to its adaptogenic and estrogen-modulating properties, which have been shown to have a positive impact on hormonal balance and mood. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
